description: Liquipedia Dota 2 wiki: plain-text introduction of one wiki page (tournament, team or player) from Liquipedia's public MediaWiki API. Dota 2 wiki only for now; the intro is the first section, not the full page. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_action_network when you need US sports betting lines from Action Network's scoreboard; sports_baseball_reference when you need MLB player season statistics, sorted leaderboard: per. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
